Bengaluru Woman Dies After Fall From Building; Boyfriend Injured

A 23-year-old woman died and her boyfriend was critically injured after they allegedly jumped from the seventh floor of a building in Bengaluru. The incident occurred in a Paying Guest (PG) accommodation. The woman was declared dead, while her boyfriend is receiving medical treatment.
